headline: Approved $1,250,000 transfer from General Fund contingency and $689,545 added to General Fund spending, plus grant-funded spending.
summary: Nine consent calendar items passed together, covering budget transfers, grant spending, and groundwater monitoring. A financial dashboard demo for school board records and a monthly revenue report were also presented. The mayor said over 3,000 building permits have been issued, and inspections are booked through December.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 13, 2026 meeting, unanimously.
Adopted the nine-item consent calendar, unanimously.
Approved a $13,652 transfer within the insurance operating budget for auto insurance, unanimously.
Approved a $13,375 additional appropriation and a $46,000 additional appropriation within two funds, unanimously.
Approved a $13,360 transfer within the code enforcement budget for vehicles, unanimously.
Approved a $60,000 additional appropriation within the Capital Projects Fund for groundwater monitoring, unanimously.
Approved a $935,860 additional appropriation within the Special Grants & Donations Fund, funded by grant revenue, unanimously.
Approved a $112,580 additional appropriation within the Special Education Grant Fund, funded by grant revenue, unanimously.
Approved a $500 additional appropriation within the Fire Department’s operating budget, funded by contributions, unanimously.
Approved a $60,000 additional appropriation within the Solid Waste Disposal Fund for solid waste barrels, unanimously.
Approved the annual meeting calendar for joint meetings of the City Council and Board of Finance through December 2027, unanimously.
Approved a $50,000 transfer from the General Fund contingency account to police repairs and maintenance, unanimously.
Approved a $49,745 transfer within the Equipment Building Sinking Fund for parking garage security cameras, unanimously.
Approved a $40,000 transfer from the General Fund contingency account for professional fees, unanimously.
Approved a $689,545 additional appropriation within the General Fund as of June 30, 2026, unanimously.
Approved a $1,250,000 transfer from the General Fund contingency account as of June 30, 2026, unanimously.
Approved a $101,021 additional appropriation and $7,995 in transfers within the Road Improvements Fund, unanimously.

plain_text:
572  
November 10, 2026 
 
 
The Joint Meeting of the City Council and Board of Finance was held on November 10, 2026 
in the City Hall Council Chambers, 111 North Main Street at 6:30 p.m. Present: Mayor Zoppo-Sassu; 
Council Members Dickau, Hahn, Kelley, Rosengren, Seymour and Tyler; Commissioners Campion, 
Maikowski, Murdock and O’Brien. Present by Videoconference: Commissioners Massarelli, Peterson 
and Tagariello. Absent: Commissioner Mace. 
 
1. FINANCIAL DASHBOARD DEMO PRESENTATION BY JEFFREY TELKE FROM 
THE BOARD OF EDUCATION. 
 
Mr. Telke from the Board of Education IT Department provided a brief demo and overview 
of the financial dashboard for the BOE financial records. He provided all board members with logins 
so they could follow along.  
 
2. APPROVAL OF MINUTES. 
 
On motion of Council Member Hahn and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To approve 
the minutes of the regular Joint Meeting held on October 13, 2026. 
  
3. ADOPTION OF CONSENT CALENDAR.   
 
On motion of Council Member Hahn and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To adopt the 
following nine items as part of the Consent Calendar. 
 
4. $13,652 TRANSFER WITHIN INSURANCE OPERATING BUDGET FOR AUTO 
INSURANCE, APPROVED. 
 
Board of Finance approval presented. 
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To transfer $13,652 within the Insurance operating budget for 
auto insurance. 
 
5. $13,375 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SPECIAL GRANTS & 
DONATIONS FUND AND $46,000 WITHIN POLICE DRUG FORFEITURE FUND, 
APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $13,375 within the 
Special Grants & Donations Fund and $46,000 within the Police Drug Forfeiture Fund. 
 
6. $13,360 TRANSFER WITHIN CODE ENFORCEMENT BUDGET FOR VEHICLES, 
APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To transfer $13,360 within the Code Enforcement budget for 
vehicles.
573 
November 10, 2026 
 
 
7. $60,000 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN CAPITAL PROJECTS FUND 
FOR GROUNDWATER MONITORING, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $60,000 within the 
Capital Projects Fund for groundwater monitoring. 
 
8. $935,860 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SPECIAL GRANTS & 
DONATIONS FUND FUNDED BY GRANT REVENUE, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation totaling $935,860 within 
the Special Grants & Donations Fund funded by grant revenue. 
 
9. $112,580 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SPECIAL EDUCATION 
GRANT FUND FUNDED BY GRANT REVENUE, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation totaling $112,580 within 
the Special Education Grant Fund funded by grant revenue. 
 
10. $500 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN FIRE DEPARTMENT’S 
OPERATING BUDGET FUNDED BY CONTRIBUTIONS, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $500 within the Fire 
Department’s operating budget funded by contributions. 
 
11. $60,000ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SOLID WASTE DISPOSAL 
FUND FOR SOLID WASTE BARRELS, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $60,000 within the Solid 
Waste Disposal Fund for solid waste barrels.
574  
November 10, 2026 
 
12. APPROVE ANNUAL MEETING CALENDAR FOR JOINT MEETINGS OF THE 
CITY COUNCIL AND BOARD OF FINANCE THROUGH DECEMBER 2027, 
APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To approve the annual meeting calendar for joint meetings of 
the City Council and Board of Finance through December 2027.  
 
13. $50,000 TRANSFER FROM GENERAL FUND CONTINGENCY ACCOUNT TO 
POLICE – REPAIRS & MAINTENANCE, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Tyler and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To transfer 
$50,000 from the General Fund Contingency account to Police – Repairs & Maintenance.  
 
14. $49,745 TRANSFER WITHIN EQUIPMENT BUILDING SINKING FUND FOR 
PARKING GARAGE SECURITY CAMERAS, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Hahn and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To transfer 
$49,745 within the Equipment Building Sinking Fund. 
 
15. $40,000 TRANSFER FROM GENERAL FUND CONTINGENCY ACCOUNT FOR 
PROFFESSIONAL FEES – ADVISOR RFP EVALUATION FEE AND ESTIMATE 
FOR RFI PROCESS, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Rosengren and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To 
transfer $40,000 from the General Fund Contingency account for Professional Fees. 
 
16. $689,545 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN GENERAL FUND AS OF 
JUNE 30,2026, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Seymour and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make 
an additional appropriation of $689,545 within the General Fund as of June 30, 2026. 
 
17. $1,250,000 TRANSFER FROM GENERAL FUND CONTINGENCY ACCOUNT AS 
OF JUNE 30, 2026, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Hahn and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To transfer 
$1,250,000 from the General Fund Contingency account as of June 30, 2026.
575 
November 10, 2026 
 
18. $101,021 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATIONS AND $7,995 TRANSFERS WITHIN 
ROAD IMPROVEMENTS FUND AS OF JUNE 30, 2026, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Seymour and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make 
an additional appropriation of $101,021 and transfers totaling $7,995 within the Road Improvements 
Fund as of June 30, 2026. 
 
19. MONTHLY REVENUE AND EXPENSE REPORT PRESENTATION BY 
COMPTROLLER. 
 
Comptroller Waldron highlighted a monthly revenue and expense report for the Joint Meeting 
members.  
 
20. OTHER BUSINESS 
 
Mayor Zoppo-Sassu pointed out that over 3,000 permits have been issued by the Building 
Department as of today, November 10th. The department is booked out through December with 
inspections. The mayor added this is a workflow issue that will need to be monitored as it’s a very 
active environment.  
 
21. ADJOURNMENT. 
 
 At 7:03 p.m., on motion of Council Member Hahn and seconded, it was unanimously voted: 
To adjourn.
